cues.text: A kitchen counter holds a wooden bowl of flour, a glass of water, and small bowls. The cook in a black apron and striped shirt mixes flour with their right hand while steadying the bowl with their left.

The cook poured water from the pitcher into the flour twice, kneading with both hands until the mixture formed a cohesive ball in the wooden bowl. Now they pull a black glove onto their left hand beside the dough.
The cook lifted the dough onto the counter, rolled it into a smooth ball, oiled it in the bowl with a spatula, and set it on the floured silicone mat. They now knead the ball flat on the marked mat.
The cook floured the mat, cut the large dough ball into portions with a bench scraper, and rolled each piece into a smooth ball lined up on the left. One ball is now flattened in the center.

The cook rolls the flattened ball into a long rectangular sheet, then sets the pin aside to brush oil across the surface with a spoon. They sprinkle flour over the oiled dough by hand from the glass dish.
The cook folded the oiled sheet in half and rolled it into a tight spiral ball, adding it to four others on the mat. A folded piece of dough rests on the mat now.
The cook rolled the floured ball into a thin round roti, flipped it, and continued rolling until the inch markings 12 down to 1 appeared on screen. The finished roti lies on the mat.
